title: A 2003 Fire Emblem Character Won a 50,000-Vote Fan Poll
hook:
In January 2017 Lyn, from the 2003 Game Boy Advance Fire Emblem, beat every newer hero with nearly 50,000 votes in the first Choose Your Legends poll. Who would get your vote?
Gameplay is from Shards of Irsa, a game I'm making.
script: Did you know a Fire Emblem character from two thousand three beat every newer hero in a vote of nearly fifty thousand fans? In January twenty seventeen, just before Fire Emblem Heroes launched on phones, Nintendo ran a poll called Choose Your Legends. Fans voted for their favorite characters from the entire series. The winner on the women's side was Lyn, the swordfighter from the two thousand three Game Boy Advance game. That game was the first Fire Emblem ever sold outside Japan. Lyn pulled in more than forty nine thousand votes from fans all over the world, far ahead of the pack. That put her ahead of Lucina from Awakening, who finished second with just under forty three thousand. On the men's side, Ike from Path of Radiance won with nearly thirty four thousand votes. Roy from The Binding Blade came second. Nintendo promised the top two finishers from each side a special version in the game. Those four Brave heroes arrived on August thirty first, twenty seventeen, and every player got to pick one of them for free. The vote became a tradition. Nintendo has run a Choose Your Legends poll every year since, and the winners still get their free Brave versions. Who would get your vote? Follow for more gaming history.
